output.review_summary: Confirmed CONTRADICTED. The restriction flag is honored for non-score jobs but not for score jobs: drain() skips only non-score jobs when restricted (store.py:0127), while the score branch (0131-0136) has no restricted check and will execute a queued score, mutating stage from the disputed band. The drain action entrypoint (0150-0152) has no restriction gate. The notify-before-release ordering (0179-0186) and verified-data use (0132, 0181) are present, and retention for verification holds (erase requires abandoned, 0210-0212). The core stop-ordinary-scoring requirement fails, so the obligation is contradicted. Minor correction to the draft: the 'queue()/retries' point is not a decisive counterexample since no path re-queues score jobs; the decisive defect is the drain() score branch.
